payload.feature:
LANDING PR #637 for decision 0006's addendum of 2026-10-11 (ending a process proves nothing about its effects, and a retry needs evidence) and research entry 0021 (#434), documents only. The operator ACCEPTED the addendum in chat on 2026-10-12, ruling each of its eight asked items as recommended:
1. The cost is counted from the journals by the build's first step.
2. A worktree-only seat's deadline kill parks.
3. A reported failure on a seat that reaches beyond its worktree parks. Ruling 2's partial-side-effect row now splits on the seat's reach, with a new binding.
4. An operator's retry of a parked `deduplicates` effect keeps its identity. Ruling 4 says so, with a new binding.
5. The authority is the pinned declaration plus the driver's echo.
6. A site-scoped identity inside panels and sequences is a follow-up.
7. Research rows 8 and 9 are follow-ups.
8. Decision 0053's ruling 5 takes an erratum.
0006 reads Built: partial (#434).

The branch story-434-design ends at 7fa2fb15:
- the design story and two fix rounds. The earlier landing (landing-pr-for-434-s-design-docu-4b45d458) ruled residual at low; its five LOWs and two INFOs are carried for #434's build;
- the controller's signed merge of main c58026c8;
- 8cd0f4a4, the acceptance:
  - the heading and an `Addendum status: accepted (operator, 2026-10-12)` line;
  - the Ruled list;
  - the matrix row's split, ruling 4's identity sentence, and the two new binding test names;
  - 0053's erratum;
  - 0006's Built line and index row;
  - research 0021's references.
Gates run on 8cd0f4a4: typos; git diff --check; decisions_index:: house_prose:: status_pages:: doc_truth:: research_registry:: passed 44, run before a final wording fix to research 0021.
- 7fa2fb15, the controller's fix of the first landing (landing-pr-637-for-decision-0006-0e307acd), which returned a SECURITY-HOLD with three HIGHs and a LOW, documents only, signed:
  - S1: the partial-side-effect row's worktree-only case now requires all three facts read from the pinned manifest (boxed hands, network off, no `writes` grant), and every other case parks, an unreadable fact included; the binding pins the `writes` grant and the unreadable case; the Ruled item says so.
  - S2: ruling 6 no longer lets `max_attempts` above 1 accept the risk of retrying a reported failure beyond the worktree; there it governs only pre-session refusals and ruling 4's deduplicated retries.
  - S3: ruling 4's operator-retry bullet carves out the parked `deduplicates` case. Ruling 7 says where the kept identity comes from without a journal change: the engine journals the retry's `effect/requested` with the parked effect's own `effect_id` and `idempotency_key`, and fold already opens whatever effect a request names (fold.rs's Retry arm sets the cursor to request an effect; its `effect/requested` arm opens the effect the payload names). The binding pins both fields.
  - S4: research 0021 says the addendum rules rows 8 and 9 follow-ups, their design unruled.
  Gates on 7fa2fb15: git diff --check; typos --hidden; quality/ratchet.sh files and clones; decisions_index:: house_prose:: status_pages:: doc_truth:: research_registry:: passed 44.

Every review position, panel member or chief, is READ-ONLY: it changes no tracked file and makes no commit, whatever this text asks below. It reports each finding. Only the implement phase fixes a finding the review returns.

Judge:
1. That the Ruled list records exactly the eight rulings above, each against the item it answers.
2. That the partial-side-effect row's split is closed and fail-closed. A seat's reach is read from its pinned facts (boundary, network, granted capabilities), and a reach the engine cannot read counts as beyond the worktree.
3. That ruling 4's identity sentence and the new bindings agree with the matrix, and no ruling contradicts another, or accepted decision 0079 or #403.
4. That 0053's erratum states the conclusion truly, that 0006's Built: partial (#434) is true, and that the index row matches.
5. That 7fa2fb15 closes S1-S4 as stated, and that ruling 7's derivation of the kept identity is true of fold and the engine at the base: a repeated `effect_id` in `effect/requested` is accepted by fold unchanged, and nothing else in the addendum still says an operator retry mints a new identity for a `deduplicates` effect.
6. That the earlier landings' carried LOWs (L1-L5) and INFOs (I1-I2) are listed for the PR. L5 (research row 6 says the executor 'acknowledges' the identity, where ruling 4 makes the pinned declaration plus the driver's echo the law) was made worse in fit by the acceptance; name any other the fix made worse.

This run lands one pull request under decision 0051, so the contribution gate can vouch for it.

For the implement phase only: if a finding returns the branch, fix exactly that finding in the documents' text. Then run, all clean: typos --hidden; quality/ratchet.sh files and clones; git diff --check; cargo test -p brokkr-cli --test it -- decisions_index:: house_prose:: status_pages:: doc_truth:: research_registry::. Documents only.

Commit one signed-off commit ending "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>", and never push. Run every command in the foreground: never background a command or schedule a wakeup, because a headless seat ends when it waits.

Threat model (operator ruling, 2026-09-26): catch realistic accidental misuse, and fail closed on what cannot be read.

instructions.analyze:
# OpenSpec analyze

Judge duplication, ambiguity, underspecification, house alignment, coverage gaps, and inconsistency across proposal, deltas, design and tasks. Treat the realm house as the constitution. Return each finding with severity and its earliest owning artifact; zero findings is consistent.
instructions.clarify:
# OpenSpec clarify

Judge underspecified areas, unquantified language, missing decisions, capability/delta mismatches, and requirements without adequate scenarios. Return every ambiguity with the evidence needed to settle it; zero findings is clear.
instructions.design:
# OpenSpec design

Write `openspec/changes/<change>/design.md`. Record context, goals and non-goals, decisions with alternatives, risks, migration, and open questions. On return, revise the design and dependent artifacts so no finding is merely acknowledged.

# OpenSpec return

Revise the returned change in dependency order. Encode an answered ambiguity as a scenario, record design choices under `## Decisions`, and keep every dependent artifact coherent. Record a reasoned refusal in the owning artifact.
instructions.implement:
# OpenSpec tasks

Write `openspec/changes/<change>/tasks.md` as numbered groups of checkboxes. Name the requirement served by every task. On return, repair the breakdown and its requirement coverage before implementation resumes.

# OpenSpec return

Revise the returned change in dependency order. Encode an answered ambiguity as a scenario, record design choices under `## Decisions`, and keep every dependent artifact coherent. Record a reasoned refusal in the owning artifact.

Change location: `openspec/changes/{change}`. Archive operation: ["openspec","archive","{change}","--yes"].

# OpenSpec archive

Folding a change is the last task: run the archive operation named above,
which moves the change directory under `openspec/changes/archive/` and
folds its deltas into `openspec/specs/`. Folding also records which change
wrote which capability, so every capability the change touched carries a
`## Provenance` list.

After the archive operation, open each capability's
`openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md` that the change touched and append
exactly one line under a `## Provenance` heading held at the end of the
file:

`- \`<archived-directory-name>\` — folded <YYYY-MM-DD>`

`<archived-directory-name>` is the directory the archive operation
created under `openspec/changes/archive/`; `<YYYY-MM-DD>` is the day it
was folded. Append only: never rewrite, reorder or remove an existing
provenance line, because standing truth accumulates and is not edited into
a different meaning. The line is a pointer, not a summary — it names the
change and nothing else, and the why stays in the change directory.

house.content:
This realm is a Rust workspace. Production code is Rust under `crates/`; the
Rust-only architecture is recorded by decision 0009. Semantic changes carry a
decision document with status `proposed` because only the operator accepts one.
Intake seats read `README.md` and decisions 0004 and 0005 before framing a
commission, along with the code and history it touches.

The frozen v1 contracts under `contracts/`, the production table at
`policy/phase-machine.json`, and `reference/` (its schemas included) are
read-only.
A contract change lands as a new version file beside the old one, never as an
edit. The evaluator corpus under `fixtures/` is also frozen and is never
regenerated, only versioned.

Tests are part of every change. Extend the suite that proves the code, run
`cargo test --workspace`, compile `recipes/self`, and leave formatting, clippy,
and the exact-coverage gate clean before reporting success.

Commit completed work with `git` using the repository's message style. Never
push.

The supported hosts are Linux and macOS (decision 0063); WSL2 is Linux. Write
no Windows-conditional code, test or evidence.

## Architecture

Decision 0071 rules how code here is shaped. Build to it, and cite its ruling
numbers in what you judge. Where a gate named below holds a rule, the gate is
the authority, and a finding it would catch is the gate's.

- **Pure core (ruling 1).** `brokkr-core` and `brokkr-view` do no I/O and read
  no clock, environment or randomness. They run no process. Pass `now`, paths
  and environment in as arguments. Effects live in the crates above core and
  view, and are journaled.
- **Enums and data, not traits (ruling 2).** A closed set is an enum matched
  exhaustively, with no wildcard arm that decides behaviour. Anything an
  operator extends is data under `adapters/`, `agents/`, `recipes/` or
  `realms.json`, validated and digested. Add a trait only for a seam whose
  contract spans several operations that must stay consistent with one
  another, reached across a process or service boundary, and name that seam
  in its doc comment. `ProducerTransport` is the one such trait today. A test
  double alone does not make a seam: a single substitutable function is a
  closure seam (`*_with`, `*_in`), which is how the house inverts a
  dependency otherwise.
- **Typed at the edge (ruling 3).** Parse wire, file and harness data once
  into a type, with `serde` and `deny_unknown_fields` where the contract is
  closed. `serde_json::Value` never goes past the edge, into state, or back
  out by string key. Never put `format!("{:?}")` in anything digested or
  journaled. A doubly-optional field or a string vocabulary is a missing enum.
- **Small functions (ruling 4).** New and changed functions stay within 100
  lines, nesting depth 5 and 7 parameters. Cyclomatic complexity follows
  the operator's 2026-09-26 ruling: a function may reach the higher of 15
  and its baseline, so a new function stays within 15, an existing one may
  change freely up to 15, and one already over 15 may only shrink.
  Production files stay within 800 lines and test files within 2,000, and a
  file already over may not grow. Add no new `jscpd` clone in production
  code, test code or data. `quality/` holds the measured baseline. Today's
  offenders carry `#[allow(clippy::…)]`, and #337 converts them to
  `#[expect(clippy::…, reason = "…")]`. Add a suppression only by a ruling,
  and remove it when you fix the function. A new suppression is
  `#[expect(…, reason)]`, never `#[allow]`.
- **Once (ruling 5).** Every fact has one home. A repeated vocabulary, skeleton
  or helper becomes one function or one table. An agent is defined once under
  `agents/`, and seats hire it by reference. A recipe that differs from another
  by a model, a seat or an entry is an `extends` overlay, never a copy. The
  agent library does not yet accept `extends`, and #360 builds it. Until then,
  a variation of an agent lives at the seat that hires it, overridden in a
  recipe overlay. It is never a second agent file that restates the first. A
  copy that must exist, such as a script a bundle pins, is held to its source
  by a test.
- **Nothing unused (ruling 6).** Add no alias, agent, contract version, flag or
  `pub` item without a consumer, and prefer `pub(crate)`. A deprecation names
  the release that removes it.
- **One derivation (ruling 7).** A fact shown on two surfaces is derived once
  in `brokkr-view`. The CLI, the TUI and `ui.html` only paint it. The engine
  never admits anything by a display-crate function.
- **Typed errors (ruling 8).** Return a `thiserror` enum whose `Display` keeps
  the operator's text. Tests match variants and pin each module's text once.
  Add no new `Result<_, String>`.
- **Tests that bind (ruling 9).** Assert exact values or variants, never
  `is_err()` alone. Show that every new test binds: a compiling mutation that
  removes the behaviour must make it fail. Restore the behaviour and record
  the failing test. Share fixtures through builders. Never change the process
  environment without a guard that restores it on unwind. A production guard
  left out because the exact-coverage gate would count it unreachable carries
  a removal-control test for the invariant that makes it unreachable, and the
  comment explaining the omission names that test.
- **The house's patterns (ruling 10).**
  - A harness is a module behind `AdapterKind`. This is the target form;
    today all five kinds share one module, and #347 and #348 build the
    split.
  - A CLI verb is a `Cmd` variant plus a handler.
  - A long parameter list becomes a parameter object.
  - Argv and mount tables are built with a builder.
  - Observing the world is split from deciding on it.
  - Never use a trait-object registry for a closed set.

Judges rate a finding against these rulings by this table, and cite the ruling
number:

- **info:** something a house gate would catch. The gate's verdict is the
  authority.
- **low:** a new or changed function over a ceiling, a rule written a second
  time, an item added without a consumer, or a `Value` carried past its edge
  within one module.
- **medium:** an untyped vocabulary that crosses crates, recipe or agent data
  copied instead of extended, a fact derived a second time on another surface,
  an error matched by its text, or a new test that cannot fail.
- **high or above:** any violation that hides a fail-open path or weakens a
  refusal. It is carried as a security finding.

A principle the implementer bent knowingly, and named with its reason in
`notes`, is still rated, and the judge carries that reason with the finding.

## Release configuration

The release manager prepares the candidate and profile patches; the operator
publishes them. Local validation is preparation work. Remote CI on the final PR
head, publication, channel updates and live-profile verification are handoff
steps, recorded as pending until their remote results exist. Historical
"live from" channel versions and old journal examples are historical facts,
not current-version references to replace.

```json

  "default_branch": "main",
  "tag_format": "v{version}",
  "version_files": ["Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock"],
  "version_update": "Bump the workspace package and six path-dependency versions together. Run cargo update --workspace --offline without upgrading registry dependencies. Measure and update the witness and compose manifest digests because the engine version participates in their identity.",
  "release_notes": "docs/releases/v{version}.md",
  "handoff_directory": "docs/releases/v{version}",

    {"name": "exact coverage", "instructions": "Run bash scripts/coverage-exact.sh in CI or host validation outside the workspace box before tagging. members.adversarial:
```
Read-only adversarial review of 7fa2fb15 against origin/main and the historical research base 3ad0f66c. Reviewed the complete five-document PR delta, 8cd0f4a4 acceptance, 7fa2fb15 corrections, the earlier landing ledger, and load-bearing fold, engine, transport, adapter and sequence source. The readiness-test delta against c58026c8 is already on main. Frozen contracts, fixtures, policy/phase-machine.json and reference have no PR delta. No tracked file changed and no commit made.

All eight accepted answers are recorded against their own questions in 0006:508-554: build-first journal cost count; worktree-only deadline kill parks; beyond-worktree reported failure parks; operator retry retains deduplicates identity; pinned declaration plus driver echo; composite site identity deferred; research rows 8/9 deferred; 0053 ruling-5 erratum. Built: partial (#434), the index row, and the absent implementation agree. The erratum's conclusion is true: engine.rs:3090 failed_to_start requires settled Failed, so Indeterminate cannot descend the model chain. The addendum explicitly defers runtime changes until #434's build at 0006:203-205.

S1-S4 close. S1: 0006:273 requires all three pinned facts (boxed hands, network off, no writes grant) before automatic retry of a reported failure; every other combination, including unreadable reach, parks. Its binding at :288-293 pins the writes grant and unreadable facts. S2: :451-456 removes max_attempts as permission to retry a reported failure beyond proven worktree reach. S3: :384-389 carves deduplicates out of the new-identity operator retry, :411-418 pins both retained fields, and :487-498 specifies reuse of the parked effect's original effect_id and idempotency_key. Historical fold.rs:426-435 copies the requested effect_id without a uniqueness check; :636-640 returns Retry to RequestEffect. Current fold.rs:469 and :665-668 preserve these semantics, and relation.rs admits the request there. Repeated effect_id therefore opens that same id unchanged (failed_attempts resets to zero). Historical and current engine.rs:1059-1069 still mint identities; this is the declared build obligation, not an already-built guarantee. No other addendum sentence requires a new identity for a deduplicates operator retry. Research :180-182 describes historical behavior. S4: research :28-30 and :47-48 correctly distinguish ruled follow-ups from unruled design. Accepted 0079's always-park transport limit and #403's unresolved-cleanup park remain explicit in matrix :272/:274 and rulings 4/5. No new contradiction permits these forbidden automatic retries.

Carried findings for the PR and #434's build (confirmed against source, also listed in .forge/ledger/landing-pr-for-434-s-design-docu-4b45d458.md):

L1 LOW, decision 0071 rulings 2 and 9: research 0021:77-79/:201 and 0006:258-262/:271 apply generic failure/lost-result behavior without the dialect_exec exception. Input: a dialect exec command exits 1, is signalled (exit -1), or exits 0 without a result file. adapters.rs:6851-6882 returns protocol Succeeded with dialect failure/pass data before the generic nonzero/file branches, and sequence.rs:482-483/:512-519 decides on that data. The claimed protocol Failed and bounded attempt retry do not follow. Inventory/classify this path separately. Carried, not worsened.

L2 LOW, ruling 9: research 0021:74 and 0006:255-257/:269 describe a lost handshake as parking today without the watchdog qualifier. Input: driver hangs before capabilities; deadline fires; cleanup settles; max_attempts=2. process.rs:460-466 checks timed_out first and returns Failed, so today's engine retries once rather than the historical park described. The future timeout row already parks it. Carried, not worsened.

L3 LOW, ruling 5: 0006:239-248 versus :269. Input: missing-secret refusal sends Accepted then Failed before spawning anything (adapters.rs:6553-6572; charter and pre-spawn invoke refusals are similar). Ruling 1's three refusal disjuncts cover none of these, but the matrix retries them. Applying the letter parks a safely refused invocation that the matrix retries. Add known pre-invocation refusal separately from model-chain failed_to_start. The letter is stricter, not fail-open. Carried, not worsened.

L4 LOW, rulings 2 and 9: 0006:250-254/:271 and research's end table omit incomplete successful receipts. Input: a third-party driver commits a marker, sends succeeded with absent/null result, cleanup settles, max_attempts=2. process.rs:665-669 synthesizes Failed through Ended::Reached, so today's engine retries. The whole-receipt rule would park, but the inventory and bindings enumerate other synthetic failure arms only. Carry this classification/binding obligation. Carried, not worsened.

L5 LOW, ruling 5: research 0021:41 versus 0006:353-371/:527-535. Input: whole-body exec declared deduplicates; driver echoes K; deadline kill; settled cleanup; no command-level acknowledgement. Ruling 4 authorizes retry, while research row 6 requires executor acknowledgement. Acceptance makes the disagreement more definite: declaration plus driver echo is the chosen law, and command acknowledgement only a later option. Align the planned research row. Recorded reason: no channel today carries the command's own word before acting. L5 is the only carried finding made worse in fit; the corrective commit worsened none of the others.

I1 INFO, ruling 5, carried index-summary omission at decisions/README.md:84: a declared/delivered lost result caused by engine restart, or unresolved cleanup, fits the summary's replay exception but the full decision always parks it. The full decision governs. Not worsened.
I2 INFO, ruling 9, carried citation mismatch at research 0021:105-106: looking up the quoted 'answers neither yes nor no' under 0053 ruling 5 finds no such sentence; it is in the rejected-alternative paragraph at :94. Not worsened.

These findings are listed here for the PR; this seat has no capability to inspect its remote body. No unresolved high/critical, new medium finding, or security residual. Foreground checks run in this review: typos --hidden passed; quality/ratchet.sh files and clones passed; git diff --check and git diff origin/main...HEAD --check passed; cargo test -p brokkr-cli --test it --offline -- decisions_index:: house_prose:: status_pages:: doc_truth:: research_registry:: passed 44, zero failures, 540 filtered. Tracked status remained clean. These validate documents, not the future runtime bindings. Verdict residual at low.
members.correctness:
Read-only correctness and fit review at 7fa2fb15. Read README, decisions 0004/0005/0071, the full 0006 addendum and research 0021, 0053 and 0079, relevant history, the prior landing ledger/results, and the cited fold/protocol/engine paths, including source at inventory base 3ad0f66c. The PR diff origin/main...HEAD contains five document files only. The readiness test and quality baseline visible against c58026c8 belong to main, not this PR. Frozen contracts, fixtures, policy/phase-machine.json and reference are untouched. No tracked files changed, no fixes or commits.

Confirmed: the Ruled list answers exactly the eight requested items, in order: journal incidence counted by the build's first step; worktree-only deadline kill parks; beyond-worktree reported failure parks; parked deduplicates operator retry keeps identity; pinned declaration plus driver echo; composite site identity deferred; research rows 8/9 follow-ups; 0053 erratum. The partial-side-effect predicate now requires all three readable pinned-manifest facts (boxed hands, network off, no writes grant), and every other case parks, including unreadable capabilities. S1 and S2 are closed in the normative text: ruling 6 no longer treats max_attempts as authorization to repeat an external reported failure. S3 is closed: ruling 4 expressly excludes deduplicates from the old new-identity operator-retry rule.
